spotify: Most browse APIs (search_songs, search_albums, search_artists, show_song, show_album, show_artist) take NO access_token; library/playlist/queue/like/download APIs DO. Check the doc's parameters list. Max page_limit is 20; page until an empty page.
spotify.show_song: Only source of per-song genre (ONE string), release_date, play_count, rating, like_count. No access_token. Library/liked/playlist/queue items lack these: call show_song(song_id=...) for each. Artists are in artists:[{id,name}].
spotify.show_song_privates: Only returns your own flags: liked, reviewed, in_song_library, downloaded. It has no play_count/rating/release_date.
spotify.search_artists: Takes query, genre, min_follower_count, max_follower_count, sort_by. No access_token. Use the genre parameter (e.g. genre='rock') to filter by genre instead of putting it in query.
spotify.download_song: Returns an error (422) if the song is already downloaded. Check show_downloaded_songs first and skip those.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Items have song_id and liked_at (not id). Paginate fully. Song library items use song_id; playlists' show_playlist returns songs[{id,...}] and song_ids.
spotify.show_song_queue: Returns the WHOLE queue as a list (takes no paging). 'Played so far incl. the current one' = the prefix up to show_current_song()['song_id']. next_song/previous_song move the pointer; stop when the target is reached.
phone.login: username is your PHONE NUMBER (from supervisor.show_profile), not the email. Password from supervisor.show_account_passwords (account_name 'phone').
phone.search_contacts: Filter people with relationship='roommate'/'coworker'/'sibling'... Contact field is `relationships` (a LIST, e.g. ['manager','coworker']), not `relationship`. Default page is 5: use page_limit=20 and page_index until empty. Match to other apps by email/phone_number.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: Returns {'date': 'Thursday, May 18, 2023', 'time': '12:00 PM'}; parse the date with strptime '%A, %B %d, %Y'. This is the only valid 'today'; datetime.now()/utcnow() give the wrong year.
venmo.login: username is your account EMAIL; password from supervisor.show_account_passwords (account_name 'venmo').
venmo.show_received_payment_requests: Filter status='pending'|'approved'|'denied' (items have no usable status field; use approved_at/denied_at being null for pending). Items have sender{name,email}. Paginate with page_limit=20. Act only on requests from the people the task names.
venmo.search_users: Returns first_name, last_name, email, friends_since. Match people by email from the phone contacts, not by name only.
supervisor.complete_task: Question tasks: answer=<minimal value>. Action tasks (do/send/add/delete/play/like...): call complete_task() with NO answer argument; an answer makes the task fail.
supervisor.show_profile: Has first_name, last_name, email, phone_number (needed for phone login), birthday, etc.
venmo.show_transactions: Items have sender{name,email}, receiver{name,email}, amount, created_at; NO direction/type/status field. Filter with direction='sent'|'received', min_created_at/max_created_at ('YYYY-MM-DD'), user_email. Paginate (page_limit<=20).
venmo.create_payment_request: 'Request money / make Venmo requests' = create_payment_request(user_email, amount, description, access_token). create_transaction SENDS money; use it only when the task says pay/send.
venmo.create_transaction: Sends real money (collateral damage if the task only asks to request). If the balance is short, add_to_venmo_balance with a non-expired card first, or pass payment_card_id. Use exact email match of the recipient.
file_system.show_directory: Takes directory_path (not path); recursive=True returns a list of path STRINGS, not dicts. Files are read with show_file(file_path=...). Bill files look like /home/<user>/bills/<kind>/YYYY-MM.txt with a line 'Total Amount => $N'; use that line, not the first $ number.
phone.search_text_messages: Read incoming messages first (phone_number=<contact number>, page_limit=20) when a task refers to what someone asked/wrote; the latest message holds the criterion. Send replies with send_text_message(phone_number, message, access_token).
spotify.show_playlist: Returns songs:[{id,title,album_id,duration,artists:[{id,name}]}] (key `id`, no song_ids). Library/search list APIs (show_playlist_library, show_album_library) return song_ids instead. No page_index here.
spotify.show_album: Returns songs:[{id,...}] (no song_ids), release_date and genre of the album. No access_token. Album-library list items have song_ids.
spotify.update_song_review: There is no rate_song API: use review_song to add, update_song_review(review_id=song_review_id) to edit. Get song_review_id from show_song_reviews(song_id, user_email=<own email>); never pass user_email=None.
spotify.search_songs: No access_token. Supports artist_id, sort_by like '-play_count' and page_limit. For 'songs by <person>' find the person with search_artists first, then search_songs(artist_id=...). Results may lack play_count: confirm with show_song.
file_system.show_file: show_file(file_path, access_token) -> {file_id, path, content, created_at, updated_at} (ISO 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS'). For 'created in <month> of this year' check created_at's YEAR (from the phone date) as well as the month.
file_system.move_file: move_file(source_file_path, destination_file_path, access_token, overwrite=False, retain_dates=False). When reorganising files, pass retain_dates=True. Print counts per destination before moving, then list the directories after to verify.
file_system.compress_directory: compress_directory(directory_path, compressed_file_path ending .zip/.tar, access_token, delete_directory, overwrite). List the directory first: only act on the folders the task names (check which level holds them).
file_system.create_file: create_file(file_path, content, access_token, overwrite). Write content verbatim. When making a file name from a title, only turn whitespace into '_' and keep other characters unless told otherwise.
simple_note.search_notes: Returns summaries WITHOUT body (note_id, title, tags, created_at...). Call show_note(note_id, access_token) for the content. Page through all pages (page_limit<=20). Keep titles/content verbatim; build outputs from parsed text, never retype.
phone.show_alarms: Pages 5 at a time by default: loop page_index with page_limit=20. update_alarm(alarm_id, access_token, time=, enabled=, label=) is a partial update: send only changed fields. create_alarm ADDS a record: never use it to repair a failed lookup. Match labels loosely (case/punctuation).
phone.delete_text_message: Filter with search_text_messages(phone_number=..., not query=). Ids are text_message_id / voice_message_id (not id). Page through everything, delete, then re-search and confirm none remain.
